Entities that have multiple or on minimum 2 faces that keep switching one to another. This only includes entities that have faces that are '''completelely''' or on minimum '''notably''' different. So, entities like [[A-200]], [[A-200i]],  [[D-35]], [[D-140]], [[M-150]], [[M-120]] and [[E-200]] doesn't count, because they don't switch faces, they only have different frames of the same image. And for [[M-120]], it doesn't count because the faces are not different enough to each other, and also because the only thing that changes on its image is the eyes.  And don't be dumb, Multimonsters are entities that '''SWITCHES''' between '''MULTIPLE''' or '''TWO''' faces on minimum. Not a entity that '''MOVES''' its face for one position to another like [[A-20]], [[A-20i]], [[A-135]], [[A-135i]], [[A-85]], [[A-85i]], [[D-5i]], [[D-55]], [[SHA-55]], [[Joke D-55|D-55i]] [[D-120]], [[SHA-120]] and [[M-22]].

Also does not include entities that ''blink'' their faces by having a face without anything and another with a design like [[SHA-60]], [[A-120]] and [[D-180i]].
